title: Support of the rescaled varifold
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be any set, let V be a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight μ_V, let c ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, R > 0, ψ(x) := c + R x and φ(y) := R⁻¹(y − c), and let W be a rectifiable n-varifold in ψ⁻¹(U) whose weight satisfies μ_W = (ENNReal.ofReal (R^n))⁻¹ • Measure.map φ μ_V. Then spt W = ψ⁻¹(spt V), where spt W := ψ⁻¹(U) ∩ spt μ_W and spt V := U ∩ spt μ_V (contract RectifiableVarifold.support; spt = Measure.support).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' U), W.weight = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • V.weight.map (fun x => R⁻¹ • (x - c)) → W.support = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.support
